answer: A concrete defence is a stake gate that forces every new agent identity to post a slashable bond before its votes count. A sybil farm must then pay that bond per shadow account, so a comet of fresh addresses gets costly fast. Collateral is graded by peer attestations, so an anchor forged by one operator never reaches the settlement threshold. At each dawn of an epoch, unproven identities lose their weight unless independently attested work backs them. Outvoting honest agents requires a bond above the honest total, and detected collusion slashes it.
